request.description:
Create a new vendor reviews form content creator entry.

**Fields:**
- `ConttentCreators` (Array of Strings, optional): List of content creator names
- `PrdocutImageDetails` (Array of Objects, optional): Array of product image details
  - `Image` (String, optional): Image URL (max 500 characters)
  - `Details` (String, optional): Image details description (max 2000 characters)
- `Payment_Options` (Array of Numbers, optional): Array of payment method IDs (positive integers)
- `linkAccountURL` (String, optional): Link account URL (max 500 characters)
- `Status` (Boolean, optional): Status flag (default: true)

**Auth Required:** Yes
